description: Records the release of a material payment against the organisation's release policy, at the moment it is released: the map_id and measure_id on file, who released it, and any exception with its reason and approver. When an agent releases under a policy with agent_autonomy tiers, the record states the tier its amount falls in and the agent_approval on record for it. Returns a Release Evidence Record, appended to the organisation's hash chain and signed. It records; it never blocks, executes or moves money. A release with no map is still recorded, flagged as a policy miss. Needs the organisation's key.

agent_approval.description: Agent releases only: { id, role } of the person who signed off a release above the policy's agent_autonomy.release_up_to. The role is the policy's agent_autonomy.approver_role.

id.description: Your own id for the person who signed off.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the released amount, e.g. 'EUR'.

value.description: Amount released, in amount.currency, greater than zero.

exception.description: Only when the release falls outside the policy: { reason, approved_by: { id, role } }.

approved_by.description: The person who approved the exception: { id, role }.

id.description: Your own id for the approver.

reason.description: Why the payment was released outside the policy, in plain words.

intent_hash.description: The intent_hash from compile_intent, so the record proves the map matches this payment.

map_id.description: The Options Map (map_id) on file for this payment, if one was made.

measure_id.description: The Measure (msr_...) on file for this payment, if one was made.

payment_ref.description: Your internal payment reference, never an account number.

policy_id.description: The organisation's release policy the payment is released under, e.g. 'pol_...'.

released_by.description: Who released the payment: { type: human | system | agent, id }.

id.description: Your own id for the releaser, e.g. an employee id or agent id; never a password or key.

uetr.description: The payment's SWIFT UETR (UUID v4), optional: ties the record to the payment itself.

name: record_release
title: Record a release
